# Bandon Point

> Bandon Point is a secluded coastal retreat in development on six private acres overlooking the Pacific, just minutes from Bandon Dunes on the Oregon Coast. It is expected to open in summer 2028; it is not yet built and is not yet available to book.

Elevated Design. Spectacular Scenery. Extraordinary Experience.

- [Golf Courses Near Bandon Point | Bandon Dunes and Bandon Crossings](https://bandonpoint.com/nearby-courses): Courses near our Bandon, Oregon oceanfront home: Pacific Dunes, Sheep Ranch, Old Macdonald and more, plus Bandon Crossings.

## Property facts
- Status: Expected to open in summer 2028. The residence is not yet built and is not yet available to book.
- Location: Six private acres overlooking the Pacific on the Oregon Coast, just minutes from Bandon Dunes
- Views: 180-degree views of the Pacific
- Setting: Grassy dunes and mature trees on six private acres overlooking the Pacific Ocean, with not another home in sight
- Bedrooms: Four king bedrooms, each with a private bath and ocean view
- Ideal for: Four golfers, yet equally inviting for couples, whether everyone plays golf or not
- Architecture: Modern Pacific Northwest architecture, designed by the architects behind Ghost Tree Grill, Round Lake Lodge, and the Lodge at Old Macdonald
- Amenities: Gourmet kitchen, expansive walls of glass framing panoramic ocean views, oceanfront hot tub, sauna, and wood-burning fireplace
- Distinction: The only vacation rental of its kind that is both close to the resort and located directly on the ocean

## Nearby golf
- Bandon Dunes: David McLay Kidd, opened 1999, 18 holes
- Pacific Dunes: Tom Doak, opened 2001, 18 holes
- Bandon Trails: Bill Coore and Ben Crenshaw, opened 2005, 18 holes
- Old Macdonald: Tom Doak and Jim Urbina, opened 2010, 18 holes
- Bandon Preserve: Bill Coore and Ben Crenshaw, opened 2012, 13 hole par 3
- Sheep Ranch: Bill Coore and Ben Crenshaw, opened 2020, 18 holes
- Shorty's: Rod Whitman, Dave Axland and Keith Cutten, opened 2024, 19 hole par 3
- The Punchbowl: Tom Doak with Jim Urbina, opened 2014, 18 hole putting course
- Bandon Crossings: Dan Hixson, opened 2007, 18 holes
